name: ICTZONE
recent: ICT Zone Asia 在 2026 年 9 月公布第二季度业绩，并宣布第二次中期股息每股 0.22 仙。公司通过 SewaJe 翻新笔记本电脑计划进入消费市场，将 TechFin 生态系统扩展至零售客户。
notable: 宣布第二次中期股息每股 0.22 仙，除息日为 2026 年 10 月 8 日。
通过 SewaJe 翻新笔记本电脑计划进入消费市场。
公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度业绩。
earnings: 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度营收为 MYR 71.95 million，环比下降 28.3%，同比增长 40.3%；净利为 MYR 4.25 million，环比下降 5.2%，同比增长 10.8%；净利率为 5.9%，高于上一季度的 4.5%。

recent_en: ICT Zone Asia announced its Q2 results in September 2026 and declared a second interim dividend of 0.22 sen per share. The company entered the consumer segment via the SewaJe refurbished laptop programme, extending its TechFin ecosystem to retail customers.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 0.22 sen per share, with ex-date on 8 October 2026.
Entered the consumer segment via the SewaJe refurbished laptop programme.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 71.95 million, down 28.3% QoQ but up 40.3% YoY; net income was MYR 4.25 million, down 5.2% QoQ but up 10.8% YoY; net margin was 5.9%, higher than 4.5% in the previous quarter.
